title: Console: Metering sanity dashboard v1 (API + UI + drilldowns)
author: Aisha Bello
release_notes: Internal-only Console dashboard for metering sanity checks (freshness, drift vs ledger, duplicates, null dimensions) with drilldowns by account/model/region and incident annotations.
description: Summary: Adds the initial Console metering sanity dashboard (v1) plus backend endpoints to power tiles and drilldowns. This is intended for Finance/RevOps + Telemetry/SRE use during the 2026Q1 metering hardening push. Motivation: We currently rely on ad-hoc SQL + screenshots to validate that usage events reconcile to the billing ledger and to spot data-quality regressions (late-arriving events, missing dimensions, duplicate/idempotency failures). This PR makes the checks visible, reviewable, and consistent across teams, and lays the groundwork for alert links/runbooks (ENG-4421 / pr-27574). Scope (v1): (1) Backend: /console/api/metering-sanity/* endpoints that query the reconciled aggregation tables and return time-series + top-K breakdowns; (2) UI: dashboard page with key tiles and a filter bar (env, time range, account, model, region, meter_type); (3) Drilldowns: click-through to a breakdown table with sample event IDs and links into existing log search (restricted). Included checks/tiles: Freshness: max(event_ingested_at) lag vs now, per pipeline stage (usage_events, usage_rollups, billing_ledger_export). Drift: % difference between usage_rollups and billing_ledger_export (billed_tokens, requests, embeddings_units) with thresholds and a 7d sparkline. Duplicates/idempotency: duplicate_event_rate (by event_id + dedupe_key), and “late_duplicate_rate” (dupes arriving > 6h after first seen). Null / missing dimensions: null_rate for account_id, model_id, region, meter_version, cache_hit fields. Outliers: p99 tokens/request and extreme spend spikes (top accounts) to help catch obvious blowups. Guardrails & access: This is Console-internal and requires billing-data entitlement. The endpoints are gated behind RBAC permission console.billing.read and are audit logged (route + filter set). No customer-facing changes in this PR. Data sources: Reads from snowflake shared views (billing_recon.usage_rollups_hourly_v1, billing_recon.ledger_rollups_hourly_v1) produced by the reconciliation export pipeline. The queries are constrained by time range and capped breakdown sizes. Performance: All endpoints are aggregated; drilldowns fetch at most 200 rows and require account filter to prevent broad scans. Notes: Thresholds displayed are initial defaults; tuning will happen with ENG-SRE as we get real-world usage/noise. Code overview (high level): Backend: console-server/src/routes/metering_sanity.ts (new), console-server/src/services/metering_sanity/*.ts (new), console-server/src/auth/permissions.ts (adds console.billing.read), console-server/src/audit/audit_log.ts (logs new routes). Frontend: console-web/src/pages/metering/SanityDashboard.tsx (new), console-web/src/components/metering/SanityTiles.tsx (new), console-web/src/components/metering/BreakdownTable.tsx (new), console-web/src/hooks/useMeteringSanity.ts (new). Schema: uses existing rollup columns; no schema migrations in this PR. Illustrative response payload (trimmed): GET /console/api/metering-sanity/drift?start=...&end=... {"series":[{"ts":"2026-02-20T14:00:00Z","usage_billed_tokens": 1234567,"ledger_billed_tokens": 1239988,"drift_pct": -0.44}],"top_dimensions":[{"dimension":"region","key":"us-east-1","drift_pct":-0.12}]} (actual response is typed and includes units + confidence flags). Rollout: Hidden behind feature flag console_metering_sanity_v1. Enabled for: Finance (billing) group, RevOps, Telemetry/SRE on-call, and Product Ops. Follow-ups: (1) Wire alert annotations + runbook links (pr-27574), (2) Add dedicated GPU-seconds view (pending pr-27492/ENG-4426), (3) Add incident timeline markers from status page/incident tool, (4) Add “shadow billing compare” toggle when available (pr-27518). Testing: Unit tests for query builders + RBAC; UI tests for tile rendering and drilldown navigation; manual verification against known discrepancy samples from Feb audit (restricted).

console-web: add SanityDashboard page + filter bar
console-web: implement tiles (freshness, drift, duplicates, null-rate) + sparklines
console-web: add drilldown table with export (CSV) for scoped results

review_conversation: Mei Lin (review): Love that this is finally in Console. Two concerns: (1) Drift math should be explicit about denominator (ledger vs usage), and (2) the drilldown endpoint can be called without account_id which could cause a large scan. Can we require at least one of account_id or model_id? Aisha Bello (author): Good catch. Updated drift series to include drift_denominator=ledger and changed label copy to “(usage - ledger) / ledger”. For drilldown, I added server-side validation: require account_id OR (model_id AND region) and cap time range to 72h if account_id missing. Also added a warning banner in UI when using non-account drilldown. Caleb Johnson (review): Query patterns look ok, but Snowflake warehouse usage can spike if someone sets 30d range with breakdown=account. Please add hard limits to topK and ensure we use the hourly rollup tables only. Aisha Bello (author): Added hard caps: max_range_days=14 for any request; max_topk=50; breakdown=account requires account filter (so top accounts tile uses precomputed “top_spend_accounts_hourly” view). Confirmed all endpoints only touch billing_recon.* hourly rollups. Logan Wright (review): RBAC looks right, but audit log should include whether the request included account_id (sensitive) and time range. Also we should log the feature flag state so we can prove who had access when. Aisha Bello (author): Updated audit log payload to include time_range_hours, has_account_filter=true/false, and feature_flag=console_metering_sanity_v1. Nadia Rahman (review): UI copy: please avoid “double billed” language; call it “duplicate usage events” and note that ledger is the billing source of truth. Also in drift tile, add a tooltip that known late-arriving events can temporarily create negative drift. Aisha Bello (author): Updated copy per spec language. Added tooltip and an “incomplete window” badge when end_ts is within ingestion_lag_slo. Ethan Park (review): Looks good. One more request: move permission name from console.billing.read to console.metering_sanity.read so it’s scoped. Aisha Bello (author): I’d prefer to keep it under billing since data is still billing-grade and we’re sharing the same entitlement group. Compromise: added new permission console.metering_sanity.read but it aliases the billing group for now; we can split later. Ethan Park (review): Works for me. Approved. Approvals: Mei Lin (approved), Caleb Johnson (approved), Logan Wright (approved), Nadia Rahman (approved), Ethan Park (approved).
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-21 by Connor O'Brien. Feature flag remains off by default; enablement coordinated with Finance/RevOps after month-end close freeze window.
